description: This Java source file defines the class `EventPublisherDelegatingSearchSession`, a custom implementation of Hibernate Search's `SearchSession`. It acts as a wrapper that delegates all method calls to an underlying `SearchSession` instance, with specific behavior added for the `search` methods. These methods notify registered listeners of search creation events before returning a search query object, enabling external customization such as adding filters. The class is used within the context of the OpenMRS project for extending search capabilities with event-driven modifications.
